strategy_version: BTC+ETH Macro Hedge V3.5 - V3.4 FINAL plus user-supplied Patch D
versioning_reason: Patch D arrived after V3.4 was frozen and changes rules V3.4 explicitly froze; it cannot be inserted into V3.4 without look-ahead/version contamination.

operational_interpretations.version_label: V3.5 and Model G are used to preserve the already-frozen V3.4 Model F evidence chain
operational_interpretations.bear_ahr999: BEAR at its unchanged 55 percent target does not enter ACCUMULATION solely on AHR999; Patch D explicitly limits value-base buying to DEEP_BEAR or an existing ACCUMULATION episode
operational_interpretations.episode_start: a successful DEEP_BEAR-to-ACCUMULATION value-base action starts an episode; a rearmed value-base action at least 14 days after a hard-failure exit starts a new episode
operational_interpretations.episode_persistence: short ACCUMULATION/DEEP_BEAR movement does not create a new episode
operational_interpretations.episode_end: NEW_BULL ends the episode; a 35-to-25 confirmed hard failure marks an exit but retains the id until a fully rearmed re-entry
operational_interpretations.hard_failure_state: 60-to-50 and 50-to-35 remain ACCUMULATION; 35-to-25 transitions to DEEP_BEAR after the one-rung sell
operational_interpretations.cooldown_clock: calendar time from the execution 4h bar of the last non-crash accumulation tactical action
operational_interpretations.same_signal_priority: Macro Bull Requalification and original NEW_BULL confirmation precede Patch D; Crash L3 remains an independent post-FSM exception
operational_interpretations.whipsaw_pair: adjacent non-crash bottom tactical actions of opposite side with execution timestamps no more than 14 calendar days apart
operational_interpretations.bottom_action_scope: AHR999 value-base, Patch-D right-side 50/60, Patch-D hard-failure sells, and the matching V3.1 B accumulation actions used for comparison
